summary: HomeStream is a TypeScript ESM pnpm monorepo for LAN media playback. Fastify 5 on Node 24 owns SQLite, TMDB metadata, gateway source discovery, NVENC transcoding, proxy caching, optional TorBox downloads and health workers. React 19/Vite implements catalog screens and now the HLS player, notifications and desktop renderer views. Electron 45 now implements a single-instance tray shell, server supervisor, mini player, settings and preload IPC. Shared Zod contracts, bridge types, analytics, flags and sanitization live in packages/shared. Dashboard tabs remain placeholders and no TV source directory exists.
architecture: Server entry loads settings/logging, creates services via buildApp, recovers encoder orphans, opens loopback proxy then LAN listener, and starts health/download workers and mDNS. PlaybackManager is now a facade over PlaybackContext, session slots, session startup, encoder lifecycle, recovery, subtitle handoff and HLS serving. Startup ranks sources, rejects downloading placeholders, probes through stable proxy URLs, computes output, and launches encoders; uncached starts can return 202 tracking instead of 201 session. Shared ranged cache, download pacer, lead gates and extractor share bound upstream use. Web requests use API client and Query; SSE health reconciliation cancels older requests. Web player pings while paused, owns cleanup/retry, track changes and desktop handoff. Desktop attaches to an existing server or owns a child; serialized restarts and session monitor avoid stale activity resurrection.
patterns: Strict TS, explicit .js server specifiers, type-only imports, shared Zod schemas, thin routes, redacted AppError envelopes with hints. Pure rules have offline unit tests. Fastify inject uses fakes and isolated temp directories/PORT=0. GPU/live tiers opt-in. No accounts, devices not auth, LAN only, always re-encode video, clients use streamId auto. Telemetry opt-in, scrubbed, nonblocking, SDKs lazy after content+idle. New file/function counted limits 400/80 with only decreasing grandfathered ceilings.
